text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">What is a cloud computer?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">A Manus Cloud Computer is a persistent computer in the cloud for your agent. With an active plan, it can run apps, scripts, and bots apart from your own laptop, and you can return to its files in a later task.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Is a cloud computer the same as a cloud PC or a VPS?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Cloud PC and cloud desktop are broad terms for a remote computer. This Cloud Computer is a cloud VM you can select for your Manus agent; with a self-managed VPS, you choose and configure the server and its software yourself. The available operating systems depend on your account.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I access a virtual machine online from anywhere?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. This virtual computer is a remote computer separate from your laptop. You can select it for a task, check it in My Computer, and access a Linux computer by SSH or its web terminal when available.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I run OpenClaw or n8n on a Manus Cloud Computer?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">You can install compatible tools on a Cloud Computer. For OpenClaw or n8n, check the software’s installation requirements against your available computer plan, then test the setup. No ready-made installation for those tools is listed in the current Cloud Computer setup.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">How do I host Discord bots or Telegram bots on Cloud Computer?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">For Discord bot hosting or Telegram bot hosting, select your Cloud Computer in a task. Ask your agent to set up the bot, add its token, test a message, and show you where to check logs or restart it.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I use it for website monitoring or as an uptime monitor?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">You can schedule website checks and save reports on the Cloud Computer. For outage alerts, choose a notification method and test it as part of your monitoring setup; a built-in uptime monitor is not listed in the Cloud Computer setup.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Does Cloud Computer keep running after I close my browser?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes, when your Cloud Computer and subscription are active, its running processes do not depend on your browser or laptop staying open. A restart, a failed process, resource limits, or a lapsed plan can still interrupt the work.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">How much does a Manus Cloud Computer cost?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Cloud Computer uses a monthly computer subscription, with additional storage charges when applicable. Published plan details are in the Cloud Computer plans guide; My Computer shows the current options and amount before you subscribe. Powering off the computer does not cancel its subscription.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Is there a Cloud Computer free plan?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">The available plans are shown in My Computer. Team free-tier accounts cannot create a Cloud Computer there; check the choices shown for your account before continuing.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Is Cloud Computer an AI agent hosting service?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">It is an AI sandbox with a persistent file system that your Manus agent can use for tasks. You can install software on it; for another AI agent, first check its requirements against the computer you have.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can computer use AI work on my Cloud Computer?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. Select an available Cloud Computer for a task and your Manus agent can use its browser, files, and installed tools. My Computer shows the computer’s status and resources; your local computer is a separate choice.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">When should I use Manus Desktop or Cloud Computer?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Use Manus Desktop for files and apps on your own computer; that work depends on your machine being on and the Desktop app running. Use Cloud Computer for an available remote computer that can keep a bot or script running without your laptop.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Which operating system does Cloud Computer use?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">You choose from the operating systems offered during setup. Linux setups include Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. Other options depend on the plans available to your account.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I access it via SSH or a web terminal?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">For a Linux Cloud Computer, its details show an SSH command and a Web terminal button. Open My Computer, select the computer, and look under its connection details.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">What happens to my files if I cancel my plan?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">A Linux Cloud Computer stays active until its subscription ends, then it is suspended. The cancellation screen warns that if you do not reactivate within 30 days, its data is permanently deleted. Back up important files before ending the plan; other systems can have different terms.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><section class="px-5 pb-24 pt-16 md:px-6 md:pb-32 md:pt-20"><div
